parsed_events: A parade marches down a street lined with palm trees under bright blue skies, drawing a large crowd of onlookers.
Vehicles drive by, some carrying flags or banners, causing the crowd to erupt in cheers as they pass.
Police cars and motorcycles patrol alongside the procession, maintaining order amidst the festive atmosphere.
Police officers ride through traffic, waving back at spectators who cheer loudly for them.
One officer rides up onto the hood of his motorcycle while others wave from inside moving trucks decorated with red balloons.
As more participants join into the festivities, they raise their arms together in celebration, further intensifying the crowd's excitement.
Firefighters pass along the road amidst cheering crowds before eventually driving away, adding to the parade's spectacle.
Bystanders take photos and videos using smartphones, capturing every aspect of the lively procession as it unfolds.
